project_title: VayuDrishti — AI/ML Tropical Cyclone Intelligence & Prediction Platform
sih_context: Smart India Hackathon 2026 Problem Statement: AI/ML based system for identification, classification, and prediction of tropical cyclone patterns using multi-source satellite data
geographic_scope: North Indian Ocean (Bay of Bengal, Arabian Sea, Indian Coastline)

typography.heading_font: Geist Mono Variable, JetBrains Mono Variable, monospace

hierarchy.h1_dashboard: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-mono tracking-tight font-bold text-slate-100
hierarchy.h2_section: text-lg sm:text-xl font-mono tracking-tight font-semibold text-slate-200
hierarchy.metric_value: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-50

routes.name: Dashboard Overview
routes.description: High-level mission control dashboard with key active storm metrics, geospatial map view, wind/pressure sparklines, satellite quick preview, and alert ticker.

routes.name: Cyclone Monitor
routes.description: Comprehensive list and detail view of active & recent cyclonic storms in North Indian Ocean, Bay of Bengal & Arabian Sea with intensity breakdown and Dvorak T-numbers.

routes.name: Satellite Intelligence
routes.description: Multi-spectral satellite imagery analyzer featuring enhanced Infrared (IR) cloud-top temperature renderings, water vapor channels, and AI contour segmentation overlays.

routes.name: AI Prediction Center
routes.description: AI/ML forecast trajectory suite showing 24h/48h/72h track cones, wind intensity curves, central pressure evolution, and estimated landfall impact coordinates.

routes.name: Historical Analysis
routes.description: Historical cyclone archive (2000-2025) for Bay of Bengal & Arabian Sea, seasonal landfall patterns, climate trends, and historical storm comparisons.

routes.name: Methodology & Architecture
routes.description: Technical overview of the VayuDrishti SIH 2026 AI/ML framework, multi-source satellite integration pipeline (INSAT-3D, Sentinel-1 SAR), and model metrics.

routes.name: Preferences & Configuration
routes.description: Fully functional user preferences page allowing customization of telemetry units, map projections, satellite color tables, alert thresholds, and refresh rates.

visual_enhancers.radar_grid: Subtle 1px tactical coordinate grid with corner crosshairs
visual_enhancers.status_pulses: Animated glowing status indicator dot for active severe cyclones
visual_enhancers.infrared_gradient: Custom SVG/Canvas color map ranging from black -> purple -> teal -> yellow -> intense crimson/white core
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Subtle background scanline effect on mission critical telemetry panels

component_guidelines.navigation: Fixed top command header with live GMT/IST timestamp clock, current active storm ticker, navigation links with subtle cyan indicator line, and quick preferences toggle.
component_guidelines.cards: Dark slate containers with sharp or subtle 6px rounded corners, cyan top accent border on active elements, explicit internal padding (p-5 or p-6).
component_guidelines.charts: Recharts implementation with dark themes, custom Tooltips styled like radar readouts, cyan and amber line strokes, area fills with translucent gradient.
component_guidelines.buttons: Tactical pill or crisp rectangular buttons with subtle hover glow, explicit data-testid attributes, clear visual states.

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, links, route triggers, metric cards, dropdowns, tab triggers, and form inputs MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-link-cyclones', data-testid='metric-active-storms', data-testid='satellite-band-selector').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly build a frontend-only React + TypeScript application with zero backend/API execution.
Ensure all typescript files (.ts, .tsx) have comprehensive interface definitions for CycloneData, Telemetry, PredictionPoint, SatelliteLayer, HistoricalCyclone, and UserPreferences.
Keep MapLibre GL as a clean visual placeholder/canvas component with interactive overlays, coordinates, and layer selectors.
Generate infrared satellite previews locally using SVG or HTML5 Canvas with custom color tables (Dvorak/BD enhancement curves) - do not make external image or satellite network calls.
Provide a fully interactive preferences page on /settings that persists user unit choices (Knots vs Km/h, hPa vs mbar) and updates global UI state.
Include realistic mock data representing North Indian Ocean cyclones (e.g. Cyclone Biparjoy, Cyclone Remal, Cyclone Michaung, Cyclone Tej).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, navigation items, cards, charts, tabs, inputs, and state selectors for robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide React icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
